performance.evidence: The enquiry sets no thermal, acoustic or security performance at all. Mark Golden asked for 'standard double-glazed units' and nothing else; there is no ITT, no specification and no Building Regulations submission in front of us. BSW have quoted 4/20/4 ECOPlus Clear Tuff Black warm edge, a 28mm unit. If this is a change of use or the fenestration is being altered under Building Regulations Part L, a U-value WILL be required and nobody has asked - but that question belongs to Bradford Watts, not to us.

ours.scope: all glass and frame products supplied and installed - defects in materials as supplied and workmanship in installation
